# C++ Report Card snapshot / 报告快照

[![C++ Report Card](badge.svg)](https://github.com/linker-bot/linkerbot-transport-cpp/actions/runs/41636452744)

This is the SVG generated by the successful ARM64
[upstream main workflow run](https://github.com/linker-bot/linkerbot-transport-cpp/actions/runs/41636452744),
using C++ Report Card Action v1.0.2 at
`9458d052f286c576d557c34d8ad43096cedbf561`.
The analyzed commit is `a46177e86e403bbd18834aedb6e81ef3233c6c22`,
the source of [release 0.3.0](https://github.com/linker-bot/linkerbot-transport-cpp/releases/tag/v0.3.0).
This is a fixed release snapshot, not a live grade for later commits.

- Analysis complete: `true`; grade: **A+**; score: **100/100**.
- clang-format: **54/54 files**; Cppcheck and clang-tidy: **37/37 compilation entries** each.
- All three tools passed with **zero diagnostics**. The grade is not test coverage or hardware validation.

Download that run's `cppreportcard-ubuntu-24.04-arm` artifact for the original
`report.json`, `report.md` and `badge.svg`.
The rule groups, source exclusions and scoring configuration were not relaxed.

CI requires complete, finding-free A+ analysis. New runs write reports and the
badge under `.github/cppreportcard/` and upload them as artifacts; they do not
commit changes automatically. Refresh this snapshot from a completed run in a
signed maintenance commit, updating the source commit, run link and SVG together.
See the [configuration and scope](../../docs/en/build.md#c-report-card).

此 SVG 来自上述成功的上游 main ARM64 工作流，使用 C++ Report Card Action v1.0.2，
固定提交为 `9458d052f286c576d557c34d8ad43096cedbf561`。
实际分析的提交为 `a46177e86e403bbd18834aedb6e81ef3233c6c22`，即
[0.3.0 发行版](https://github.com/linker-bot/linkerbot-transport-cpp/releases/tag/v0.3.0)的源码。
这是固定的发行版快照，不是后续提交的实时评分。

- 分析完整：`true`；等级 **A+**；分数 **100/100**。
- clang-format 完成 **54/54 文件**，Cppcheck 与 clang-tidy 各完成 **37/37 编译单元**。
- 三个工具均通过，**零诊断**。等级不代表测试覆盖率或实机验收。

对应运行的 `cppreportcard-ubuntu-24.04-arm` 附件保留原始 `report.json`、`report.md`
和 `badge.svg`。本轮没有放宽规则组、源码排除范围或评分配置。

CI 要求完整、零诊断的 A+ 分析。后续运行会把报告和 badge 写入 `.github/cppreportcard/`
并上传为附件，不会自动提交。更新快照时，应从已完成的运行取得 SVG，并在签名维护提交中
同步更新源码提交号和运行链接。[构建指南](../../docs/zh/build.md#c-report-card)说明配置和范围。
